notes.title: 🌟Shueisha Games Partners with SIGONO for "OPUS: Prism Peak" Global Release! 🌟
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42258172/26d0ce3f318a67687f533510e28cf726afd64252.png
Greetings, OPUS Enthusiasts!

We're thrilled to share some electrifying news from the Taipei Game Show! Shueisha Games is now the global publishing partner for SIGONO's latest adventure, "OPUS: Prism Peak"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42258172/010676390f0173362b247116e669ab80118b812c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42258172/7f2ff40e8c6eebcd8d792c2af559f797fa7664a6.png

A Dynamic Collaboration

This exciting collaboration between SIGONO and Shueisha Games begins a new chapter in bringing the latest in the OPUS series to a global audience. Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey with "OPUS: Prism Peak"!

Follow Us for the Latest News

Don't miss out on any announcements or special events! Follow us and join our community for exclusive content and updates.
